_tuning_notes: Nile crocodile in swamps. Neutral on land, ambush predator in water: lunge_range is the scan radius in blocks, grab_ticks the drag duration (40 = 2s with two chews at half attack each). Not tamable, not breedable (no items set). Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey).
guide_blurb: The river is its dinner table. Stay off the tablecloth.
